newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Barrot proposes time off for overtime.
newsitem.headline: France's Barrot proposes time off for overtime.

text.p: French Labour and Social Affairs Minister Jacques Barrot proposed on Monday to compensate workers' overtime with time off instead of extra pay as a way to ease the jobless rate.
He threatened to draft legislation on the issue if companies and trade unions disagreed with his proposal.

"An inter-professional negotiation must start to assess how at a certain threshold, it (overtime) could be compensated other than financially, by granting free time," Barrot said in an interview with French daily Le Parisien.
He said the move would lead to hiring of additional workers.
"We are considering taking a legislative initiative" in the event that negotiations on the issue stall.
